messages:
sarah_sales: Hey team — ACME POC seeing intermittent SSE disconnects on our hosted endpoint. Client (browser) gets partial chunks and fails JSON.parse on final buffer. Repro on Chrome and Node fetch. Any ideas? @jon_eng @pat_support

jon_eng: Can you paste the client error and request headers? Suspect chunked transfer closing early or keep-alive issue.

sarah_sales: Client error/stack:
```json
SyntaxError: Unexpected end of JSON input
    at JSON.parse (<anonymous>)
    at streamHandler (app.js:45:12)
```
Server log snippet shows a 200 then `stream closed by peer` around same time. Link to logs: https://logs.redwood/acme/poc/1234

pat_support: Starting a quick support swarm. @maya_devex can you run our SSE harness against their endpoint and capture frames? Also ask customer for HAR + server request-id when it fails.

maya_devex: Repro'd locally with our harness — saw same partial chunk. Hypothesis: intermediate proxy (nginx/ALB) idle timeout cutting long-lived SSE before event delimiter. What are their proxy keepalive/timeouts?

jon_eng: Also verify we're emitting proper SSE boundaries and flushing per event. Example server code we use:
```js
res.write(`data: ${JSON.stringify({text: \"hello\"})}\n\n`);
```
If an event's JSON spans multiple TCP packets and the client treats several events as one, parsing fails.

sarah_sales: Customer reports truncated last object ~70% of the time; they see many small fragments instead of whole events. They're on ALB in front of CloudFront.

pat_support: Mitigation plan: 1) add explicit event boundary marker (event: end) 2) flush per-event so proxies see activity 3) raise ingress timeout on the POC load balancer where possible. Can we patch the POC instance?

jon_eng: I'll push a small patch to force res.flush() after each event and attach `event: end` for final chunk. Deploying to poc canary now.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy initiated for service/redwood-poc on env/dedicated-poc-3 by jon_eng at 1763005498

deploy-bot: Canary deploy succeeded — 1763005498. Health checks passed.

maya_devex: Ran synthetic client against canary — no disconnects in 5m window, events arrive as complete JSON. Need customer HAR to be sure on their infra. I'll paste capture instructions.

sarah_sales: Sending mitigations to ACME + HAR instructions. Will reconvene after they test. Thanks all :pray:
